item.title: Version 1.0.12
item.description:
What's new

  • Your pet now has its own personality: Boo pulls pranks, Pip trips over his own feet and Mochi blows bubbles.
  • Pet your pet with the mouse for hearts, and hand out snacks you earn by finishing tasks and focus rounds.
  • After an event your pet asks how it went, and after a meeting it can collect your to-dos.
  • Meeting reminders now show the agenda, your note from last time and related open tasks.
  • During focus time your pet works right next to you and types along when you type.
  • Your pet reacts to your Mac: low battery, the charger, lost Wi-Fi, heat and very late nights.
  • Drop a file, picture or text onto your pet to summarize it, translate it, read the text, save it as a to-do or hand it to Claude.
